QTCP Werner window-size and Werner-parameter update.
Update rule: W_next = W + gamma * (target_tp - observed_tp).
Update rule: w_next = w + gamma * ((tp_plus - tp_minus) / (w_plus - w_minus)).
The plus/minus Werner runs use the old W_run from the same iteration.
Werner parameter is clamped to [1.0e-6, 0.999999] so request_rate stays positive.

Initial update parameters:
  target_tp = 2.4
  iterations = 3000
  initial_window_size = 20
  initial_werner_w = 0.75
  min_window_size = 1.0
  werner_bounds = [1.0e-6, 0.999999]
  rng_seed = 42
  parallel_within_iteration = true
  julia_threads = 24
  throughput_repeats = 10
  gamma(n) = 1 / (n + 100)^0.7
  delta(n) = 0.05 / (n + 50)^0.15

Default simulation parameters:
  werner_w = 0.75
  chi = 30.0
  request_rate = nothing
  distance_km = 25.0
  a_eta = 1.0
  beta_per_km = 0.046
  detector_a_p = 0.9
  detection_prob = nothing

  source_ack_timeout = 10.0
  sim_time = 500.0
  success_prob = 1.0

  memory_slots = nothing
  initial_request_delay = 0.0
